description: This file contains Sass functions and mixins used for evaluating source code, handling color contrast, string replacement, and retrieving theme colors in Bootstrap's styling framework.
external_files: variables or maps such as $colors, $theme-colors, $grays, which are expected to be defined elsewhere in the Bootstrap SCSS codebase

methods.name: _assert-ascending
methods.description: Mixins to validate that a Sass map is in ascending order.

methods.name: _assert-starts-at-zero
methods.description: Mixin to ensure the first breakpoint value is zero.

methods.name: str-replace
methods.description: Function to replace all occurrences of a substring within a string.

methods.name: color-yiq
methods.description: Function to determine if a color is light or dark based on YIQ contrast.

methods.name: color
methods.description: Function to retrieve a color from the $colors map.

methods.name: theme-color
methods.description: Function to retrieve a theme color from $theme-colors.

methods.name: gray
methods.description: Function to retrieve a gray shade from $grays.

methods.name: theme-color-level
methods.description: Function to compute a theme color shade at a specific level.
